name: multi-select
title: Multi select
description: Type to filter a list and pick several options, shown as removable tags.
a11y: ARIA 1.2 combobox with a listbox that has aria-multiselectable; options carry aria-selected.
ArrowDown/ArrowUp move, Enter toggles the active option, Escape closes, Tab leaves.
Backspace in an empty field removes the last tag; each tag has a button named "Remove <label>".

props.name: options
props.description: The choices, each with a `value`, a `label` and an optional `disabled`. The user filters them by typing part of the label.

props.name: value
props.description: The chosen option values when controlled. Pair with `onValueChange`.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: The initially chosen option values when uncontrolled. Default empty.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Called with the full list of chosen values.

props.name: size
props.description: `md` (default), `sm` for dense layouts or `lg` for prominent forms. Heights match Button, Input and Select at each size.

props.name: invalid
props.description: Marks the field as having an error: sets `aria-invalid` and shows the error border.
